answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in jetty, queued in voyage, and signal publishes the wait time. A farm of 58 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1681 identities would post 3018 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
